jobs.description:
Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Buyer (m/f/d).

What your job includes

As a Buyer, you are responsible for purchasing and calling off products, materials, and services for the factory from suppliers, manufacturers, and wholesalers both domestically and internationally. You maintain good relationships with suppliers and monitor their performance.

- Daily processing of purchase proposals and orders for raw materials and goods
- Organizing the local purchasing and ordering process
- Determining and organizing delivery times, order quantities, and order schedules
- Monitoring and checking the nature, quantity, and quality of the ordered goods
- Handling and following up on complaints when delivered goods do not meet expectations
- Maintaining master data related to purchasing-relevant information
- Performing other tasks as directed by the supervisor

What we expect from you

- Strong coordination and organizational skills 
- Good negotiation skills, a professional demeanor, and persuasiveness
- Analytical insight
- Creative and solution-oriented mindset
- Good team spirit and ability to collaborate
- Excellent skills in MS Office and ERP systems
- Fluency in English and Dutch

What We Offer You

We are a company with flat hierarchies, strong values, and a clear focus on our customers. We know that our employees are the key to our success. That is why we quickly give you responsibility and help you grow according to your talents.

- A responsible role within the purchasing and ordering process
- A professional work environment where you collaborate with various internal and external parties
- A position with international contacts with suppliers
- A work environment where accuracy, organization, and collaboration are central

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

What Benchmark has to offer to you:

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

What do we ask of you?

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.

About Benchmark:

Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.

Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. In Almelo, the Netherlands, you will be working with up to 750 colleagues.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Grundkenntnisse: Wartung, Reparatur, Instandhaltung
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Feinlöten, Hartlöten, Löten, Weichlöten, Maschinenführung, Anlagenführung, -bedienung

Welding Robot Operator

The company is looking for a Welding Robot Operator for the robotics department. In this role, you will be responsible for the automated welding process of high-quality stainless steel welded assemblies and will also perform various metalworking tasks. You will work in a production team with one or more welding robots, assessing and reworking products as needed. As a robot operator, you will monitor the functioning of the welding robots and the welding quality. The welds will be visually inspected, and any deviations will be monitored and discussed to ensure continuous process improvement. The plate thickness varies between 2 and 5 mm.
Team
There are different products: box frames, center arms, fences and grates, central units and boiler frames, collectors, M4use.
 What Will You Be Doing? 
▪ Operating and configuring the welding robot 
▪ Monitoring product quality 
▪ Improvement
What skills Do You need?
▪ You can weld in both Mig/Mag and Tig modes.
▪ Experience with welding robots.
▪ You are fluent in English.
▪ You are motivated and can work accurately.

What does the company offer?
    Salary between 20-21 euros gross/hour for 38 hours/week. With overtime (depending on client’s requirement): You can earn between 700-800 euros net/week (excluding housing and health insurance).
    Single Private Room in shared house
    Shared Company car or Travel allowance
    Weekly payment and long-term contract

AT The Family Business: 
    They have a close and friendly team where teamwork is key.
    They work with the best materials and state-of-the-art machinery in the safest and most organized work environment. They value order and cleanliness. 
    They manufacture high-quality products for special clients

The Analytical Center of Excellence (ACE) organization is looking for a 
Junior Analytical Technician 
(full shift) in the Chemicals lab located in Terneuzen, The Netherlands.
 

The Chemicals lab in is one of the Manufacturing Production Quality (MPQ) labs that performs analysis of plant-samples in Terneuzen. Servings multiple production plants such as polyurethanes and polyglycols results in the need for a 24/7 service and a full-shift roster to perform the analysis of all plant samples.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Ensure service requests are accurately run, and the data returned as per sample plan. 

• Analytical equipment operations and troubleshooting as per procedures. 

• Provide input of quality data into LIMS, document and communicate results. 

• Perform calibration and first line-maintenance of analytical equipment. Document/administrate these maintenance activities. Communicate maintenance work when required. 

• Apply Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Analytical Work Process and Operating Discipline/Quality System procedures and practices as well as cGMP/pharma standards. 

• Participating in and completing of laboratory training and corporate required trainings. 

• Co-operate and communicate with co-workers and clients to maintain workflow and instrumental information, and to share and leverage problem solving and prevention expertise. 

• Contribute to value creation by continuous improvement of procedures in the analytical work processes and related tools and performance metrics. 

• Promote a well-organized, responsive, efficient workplace and work well both as a team member and independently. 

Qualifications
 
 

• MBO-4 laboratory degree or similar (bachelors degree preferred). 

• Fluent in Dutch and English. 

• Experience in an industrial laboratory (analytical) 

• Able to work in full shift (24/7 roster): morning, afternoon and night shifts.  

 
 

Preferred qualifications
 
 

• GMP/pharma experience. 

• Experience in operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of analytical equipment. 

• Knowledge of quality data systems like LIMS, OpenLab, etc. 

• Good lab techniques, methodical record keeping, and the ability to work both independently and with co-workers. 

• Excellent human relations, organizational and communication skills are necessary to communicate with team members, partners and outside customers. 

• Exhibit confidence in confirming validity of methods and data. 

• Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.

Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development. 

Requirements

- MBO/ vocational working and thinking level
- Experience in a production environment
- Forklift and reach truck certificate is a plus
- Team-oriented collaboration
- Good communication skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Knowledge of safety regulations
- Good command of Dutch or English

- Salary €17.50 per hour excluding shift allowance
- Full-time employment
- Working in a 5-shift system
- Travel allowance
- Holiday pay

- Autonomy, willingness and ability to work remotely
 

- Flexibility to deal with last minute changes, can-do attitude, problem solver, ability to remain calm under pressure

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you will join an international engineering and consultancy firm specialising in the design and delivery of complex technical projects.

Within this position, the focus is on Mission Critical Facilities and data centres. These are technically demanding buildings where systems such as electrical power supply, cooling, redundancy, safety and operational continuity need to be closely integrated.

You will become part of a Belgian engineering team that is being further developed around data centre projects. From Belgium, you will work closely with international engineering teams on projects for both national and international clients.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where different technical areas of expertise come together to design and deliver complex projects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

Performing the job correctly contributes to good results and a stronger team. That is why flexibility, eagerness to learn, common sense and stress resistance are essential. Do you have an ETP certificate or a forklift certificate? That is a plus, but not a requirement.

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

As an AP Accountant based in Merksem, you will play a key role in managing accounts payable processes within the industrial and manufacturing sector. This permanent position involves handling financial transactions and ensuring accuracy in the accounting and finance department.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Omschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.
